column2: Current UF master displays five antitumor treatment cohorts signed as enrolling, observational Palladia sampling, postoperative pain measures and cementoplasty as closed. Reconciled eligible IDs against every oncology card.
Exact UF osteosarcoma vaccine: appendicular and untreated, six owner-paid doses after UF amputation; only injection reaction care up to $100.
Exact UF splenic HSA vaccine: splenectomy and chemotherapy time windows, vaccine about $1,275, unchanged protocol prerequisites.
Linked UF melanoma body, stable official HTTPS destination and current recruiting wording; early resectable or minimal disease plus owner-paid dosing.
Individual UF trametinib primary aligns with now visible UF master entry; named Gainesville active site and explicit washouts and funding conditions.
RNA vaccine + PD-1, mandatory RT and biopsy before RT, separate from six-dose post-amputation vaccine; mild metastasis possible by investigator review.
Owner-paid standard toceranib on declared research schedule, experimental objective biomarker resistance; no treatment assignment or forced addition to matchable.
Bone-stabilizing cementoplasty alongside standard radiotherapy, direct detail text still enrolling versus master closed; do not choose by URL status.
Investigator has one public current recruiting cohort: feline small-cell gastrointestinal lymphoma via whole-abdomen radiation.
Current structured clinical details confirm active single site, funding split, 7-day washouts, contact and no end date.
January FISS flyer read individually; exact ethics/protocol ID absent despite same investigator. Price not attributable to current ADAM-12.
Read the complete Copenhagen current and completed listings, separated Danish–Swedish FLASH from postmortem hydroxyapatite and specimen-only cohort.
Recruiting patient roster confirms FLASH patient type and enrollment contact; archived hydroxyapatite title links back to exact completed ex-vivo project.
Current Zurich Lattice versus SBRT both arms receive confirmed five-day RT; correct refusal handling independently of retained costs from unavailable PDF.
Current meningioma flyer specifies MRI/CT diagnosis plus consent to sample; planning CT and all ten RT sessions owner-paid, MRI and biopsy paid.
Official high-grade glioma PDF verifies all patients receive RT and one arm also lomustine+TMZ; placebo other arm, biopsy/drugs covered, RT discounted.
Current FLASH feline oral SCC clinic says discounted RT and follow-up; its exact standard costs flyer remains restricted, old amount not re-attested.
Heart-base chemodectoma monitoring is five days of routine RT plus research echo, Holter, troponin; only cardiac tests covered, no study-assigned anticancer treatment.
Pituitary/adrenal tumors receive stereotactic RT as regular treatment; only post-RT hormone measurements and followup are studied and funded.
Defined one dose vinorelbine Phase I toxicity with some foundation support; no continuing anticancer course or conversion to matchable.
French CICV actual Lyon protocol reviewed; Oncowaf supplemental same-identity filters distinguished from official body.
Milan direct patient protocol for FAP-positive tumors, exact OPBA822022 and funding split, no dated active slot confirmation.
